title.narrative: Fact-finding Study on Sustainable Beef Sector in Bolivia

description.narrative: This fact-finding study aims to investigate the environmental impact of livestock in the beef cattle industry in the regions of Santa Cruz, Beni, and Pando in Bolivia. The study also seeks to establish a sustainable industry in the regions while identifying opportunities for long-term collaboration between academic institutions and public and private organizations from the Netherlands and Bolivia. The project will focus on capacity building, knowledge transfer, technology, and innovation to achieve this goal.

Agriterra was contracted to elaborate a fact-finding study of the beef cattle industry with focus in the regions of Santa Cruz, Beni, Pando, and El Chaco in Bolivia; which concentrates most of the beef production in the country. The results of this study contribute to a better understanding of the current production of beef in the country, with concrete identification of the environmental effects of livestock and the opportunities of improvement for setting up a sustainable industry. The project also identifies the following opportunities for bilateral collaboration between the Netherlands and Boliviafor a sustainablebeef value chain:
